 Order

This is an application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of Criminal Procedure Code (Cr.P.C.)
filed by the sole accused in Crime No.1294/2023 of Malayinkeezhu Police Station,
Thiruvananthapuram registered under Sections 376(2)(n)m 354(D)(1)(i) and Section 506 IPC.
2.
The prosecution allegation is that, on 25.10.2018, the petitioner took the de-facto complainant to his sister's house and committed rape on her, on promise of marriage.
In 2019 also, he had sexual intercourse with her, at his relative's house.
Thereafter, he threatened her by using her nude photographs.

3. Heard learned Senior counsel appearing for the petitioner, learned Public Prosecutor, and also learned counsel for the additional 2nd respondent/de-facto complainant.
4.
Learned Public Prosecutor vehemently opposed the bail application stating that there is an allegation that the petitioner misused her nude photographs.
So the mobile phone of the petitioner has to be seized and the investigation has to be completed.
5. Learned counsel for the de-facto complainant would point out that, Crime No.1272/2023 of Vanchiyoor Police Station was registered against the very same petitioner filed by another lady.
Moreover, the petitioner introduced himself to the de-facto complainant as a Commando in Police Force, doing duty in Sree Padmanabhaswami Temple, Trivandrum.
The allegations in the crimes registered against him are unbecoming of a Police Officer.
The two crimes will show that he is indulged in such activities regularly and so his bail application cannot be entertained.

6. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner was in a live-in relationship with one Miss.Gopika, who was a friend of the de-facto complainant in this case, and later, they got separated going by the prosecution allegations.
The offences alleged in the present crime occurred during the period of live-in relationship with Smt.Gopika, and that itself will falsify the case of the de-facto complainant.
Moreover, the alleged incident occurred in the year 2018-19 but the compliant was filed only in the year 2023.
So, there is no bonafides in the complaint and he is entitled to be released on bail.

7. Considering the fact that the petitioner is a Commando in Police Force and there are two crimes registered against him similar in nature, registered on the basis of complaints filed by two ladies,
this Court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to him.
8. He is directed to surrender before the investigating officer on 22.01.2024 and subject himself for interrogation.
In the event of arrest, he has to be produced before the Jurisdictional Magistrate Court on the date of arrest itself.
This bail application is dismissed, accordingly.

Sd/-
